description: Implementation of RXRingBuffer and PacketBuffer classes for RTP media packet handling in Android's media framework, including buffer management, gap detection, and timeout handling.

classes.name: AAH_RXPlayer::RXRingBuffer
classes.description: Ring buffer for RTP packets with sequence management, gap detection, and retransmission handling.

classes.name: AAH_RXPlayer::PacketBuffer
classes.description: Buffer for storing individual RTP packets with allocation and destruction methods.

methods.name: AAH_RXPlayer::RXRingBuffer::pushBuffer
methods.description: Adds a packet buffer to the ring, handling sequence normalization and duplicate detection.

methods.name: AAH_RXPlayer::RXRingBuffer::fetchBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the next packet buffer from the ring, considering gaps and initial fast start.

methods.name: AAH_RXPlayer::RXRingBuffer::fetchCurrentGap
methods.description: Detects current gap in the packet sequence within the ring buffer.

methods.name: AAH_RXPlayer::RXRingBuffer::processNAK
methods.description: Processes NAK requests to skip over missing packets.

methods.name: AAH_RXPlayer::PacketBuffer::allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory for a packet buffer of specified size.
